Match exactly the indigo orca hood with white forehead patch, peach face, coral cheeks, white gloves, short limbs, indigo shoes, clean thick indigo outlines and restrained lavender shading. One full-body character centered, square composition with 8% clear margins, transparent background. No text, no scenery, no watermark. Friendly open expression, holding with both hands an open small toolbox containing simple pastel modular blocks and a document, offering useful resources to viewer.
